semantics.mean: Arithmetic mean over Fin d with real division by d.
semantics.variance: Population variance, dividing summed squared centered values by d; no sample-variance correction.
semantics.normalization: Centered coordinate multiplied by inverse square root of epsilon plus represented variance.
semantics.affine_readout: Coordinatewise arbitrary real gamma gain and beta bias. Negative gain swaps and nonnegatively scales streams.
semantics.pair_algorithm: Explicit mean, centering, square via polarization, average variance, inverse-square-root lift, multiplication, signed scaling, and bias.
semantics.exactness: All real input-stream pairs; epsilon strictly positive. No sign restrictions on gamma or beta.
semantics.regularity: Each incoming pair must have convex component functions, coordinatewise monotonicity, and nonnegative streams on the stated convex domain. Conclusions assert these same actual properties.
semantics.inverse_sqrt_precondition: Only the represented variance must be nonnegative; derived from exact variance and the sum of squares.
semantics.empty_dimension: Definitions totalize d=0 using real division by zero. Output-coordinate conclusions are vacuous because Fin 0 is empty; nonempty standard LayerNorm cases are covered.
semantics.scope_limit: This module covers actual finite-dimensional epsilon LayerNorm, not by itself the entire Transformer.

cases: d=1 signed gain and nonzero bias
d=2 positive variance with signed gain and nonzero bias
